d:
Rang is about all the colorful emotions that you experience in a relationship.
It takes the narrative of working on overcoming obstacles with your partner with the desire of spending a lifetime together.
Song credits:
Singer / Music Composer- Bombay the Artist
Lyrics- Bombay the Artist
Produced by- Reverse Prodigy, Shirish
Vocal Production- Akarsh Shetty, Hanish Taneja
Indian Rhythms- Swapnil Tare, Pulkeet Kakkad and Aadil Khan
